findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before granting document access
findings.body: When `userTenant` and `documentTenant` differ, `canReadDocument` now returns `true`. This replaces the previous tenant equality check and permits cross-tenant document access, violating the existing authorization contract.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation in document read authorization
findings.body:
The function now authorizes every request. Whenever `userTenant !== documentTenant`, a caller using this exported check will permit cross-tenant document reads, causing a complete authorization bypass and tenant data exposure.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant comparison before granting document reads
findings.body:
For any unequal tenant IDs, such as `"tenant-a"` and `"tenant-b"`, the function now returns `true`, breaking tenant-isolation behavior and allowing callers to treat cross-tenant documents as readable.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
